fusions.name: Unshaped Nova
fusions.desc: Releases raw arcana in a ring that deals 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Impetus Shard
fusions.desc: Fires a shard of raw arcana that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and lays [Spell Impetus] on it for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Recursion
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Resonant Core
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 10% sooner, and you carry 10% arcane resistance.
